name: Arcane
special_rules: Raw elemental manipulation (Fire, Frost, Lightning), telekinesis, force wards, and scholarly enchantments.

name: Blood
special_rules: Pays casting costs directly from Stamina (STA) instead of Essence (ESS); powers hemomancy, crimson curses, and vitality transfer.

name: Shadow
special_rules: Shadow-stepping, darkness generation, illusions, invisibility, and umbral strikes.

name: Demonology
special_rules: Can sacrifice 2 STA per 1 ESS to fuel or upcast spells; Fumbles (96–00) trigger immediate backlash or fiendish rebellion.

name: Necromancy
special_rules: Soul-draining, bone armor, raising undead thralls, and necrotic decay.

name: Druidic
special_rules: Primal weather, entangling roots, stone-shaping, thorn-barriers, and natural regeneration.

name: Spiritual
special_rules: Ancestral/divine invocation, spirit-warding, radiant smiting, exorcism, and soul-mending.

name: Ki
special_rules: Enhances unarmed/melee strikes, iron-body deflection, blinding speed bursts, and pressure-point strikes.

name: Warg
special_rules: Lineage-gated to Sylvan Elves, Wilder Elves, Wendhya, and Weirgoth Dwarves. Bonds with beasts, projects senses into animal companions, or shifts into primal beast forms.

name: Witchcraft
special_rules: Hexes, evil-eye curses, fate-twisting, poultices/brews, and folk charms.
